The word RE-EARNED appears in no amended wording: nothing is re-earned, because the original sets remain unexhibitable.

alternatives: the falsifier could have been homed in a sidecar record outside the claim store (rejected in sec.7.5(3)'s reasoning: the lifecycle machinery reads the claim's own record, and a sidecar falsifier is invisible to it)
claims.boundary: The generator fix changes no claim's content and appends nothing by itself; the append is the amended freeze's act, and this draft performs no freeze act. The sec.6 gates govern the amended run only; the unamended draft's closures stand in the record as the 2026-10-21 attempt left them.

evidence.description: The generator finding and the two-way proof, recorded in adjudication.md sec.7.3 and amendment.md sec.7: the carry-over's preserved-field list, the failure mode with the unmodified generator, and verbatim survival with the fixed one.

falsification_tests: regenerate-and-read-back is the test, and it is repeatable on demand: append a condition to any extracted record, regenerate, and read the field back - absent, the fix has regressed and the amended freeze may not proceed

metadata.strongest_rival: a fix that preserves the field only for this one claim (excluded: the carry-over is by claim identity for every record, which is what the proof's read-back on the yadav record demonstrates)
metadata.verdict_rule: the regenerate-and-read-back proof, rerun at the amended freeze before the append, is the judge

claims.text: The claim-store generator act (sec.7.5(3), decided 2026-10-23) is performed as part of this amendment: the regeneration carry-over in glossa-indus/scripts/indus_claims.py preserves falsification_condition by claim identity, so a falsifier appended to a claim record survives regeneration. The fix is prepared in the amendment's PR as a separate commit touching only that file, and was proven before proposal (amendment.md sec.7): with the unmodified generator an appended marker condition on yadav_2009_arxiv_manual_002 is absent after regeneration; with the fixed generator it survives verbatim, the only other differences being the regeneration timestamps measured as baseline noise. The amended freeze then appends the falsifier text of amendment.md sec.8 to yadav_2009_arxiv_manual_002's record, with the dated note the amendment specifies, and registers the claim-record hash after the append. Under the amendment, step 0 runs the gates of amendment.md sec.6 (pin checks, STRICT CORPUS NOT PINNABLE, TOO THIN, SECOND ARM NOT RUNNABLE, determinism in place of BATTERY NOT REPRODUCED) in place of the retired closures.

note: Draft register for Spec 054 (design D-08, PR #195 packet), opened 2026-10-21 under the runnable-experiments campaign plan approved by the owner AS WRITTEN on 2026-10-21 (campaign member 7) and the portfolio triage of the same date (design D-08 found RIPE). Conventions as in Specs 042-048: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-PHASE43-RECORD (the Phase-43 files of record state the original counts and rates), ASM-CLAIM-RECORD (the extracted-claims file is the claim's record of standing), ASM-V3-DATABASE-POSTURE (the strict/V3 corpus is held in the database, per Spec 033 section 4, and is pinned as a step-0 act, not at draft), ASM-HOLDAT-LAYER (a Holdat layer identifiable in the program's holdings is arm 2's corpus, pinned at step 0), ASM-CROSSWALK-OF-RECORD (the Phase-122 crosswalk v1 is the join of record between compilations; conflict pairs are a stated class, never noise), ASM-THRESHOLDS-FROM-RECORD (the battery's threshold rule is recoverable from the record in a form the freeze can state and gate 0.3 can prove), ASM-ORIGINAL-SETS-EXHIBITABLE (the original 40/20 sets can be exhibited in full from a pinned source), ASM-SEGMENTATION-AS-PUBLISHED (each compilation's segmentation conventions are as its published record states), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes and the falsifier append; frozen records are never edited). Amendment claims F054-C16-C19 added 2026-10-23 under the owner-approved waiting-decisions package (Item 3), drafting only; the register stays at 0.5-draft and unfrozen.
